decisions.statement: Stop blocked rather than pick one of the two conflicting team decisions for the 0-balance sweep; no change to src/Ledger or tests, because any sweep implementation must choose a behaviour for the 0-balance case and so would silently override one team's recorded decision.

claim.blockedReason: LEDGER-V7-R1 cannot be met as written: DEC-V7-EMPTY-NOOP requires sweeping a 0-balance source to return Ok with the ledger unchanged, while DEC-V7-ONE-PAIR requires every accepted sweep to record exactly one posting pair and a sweep that would record no postings to be refused with Error (InvalidAmount 0m). The acceptance criteria say each statement must hold; for a 0 balance they are mutually exclusive. Both are team decisions of equal standing, neither narrower nor newer, so the conflict needs a decision from Operations and Audit (or the requirement owner).
